info.name: irken font
info.description: the Irken language for your computer, haza!

style.css:
@font-face {
    font-family: "Irken Alphabet FIXED";
    src: url("data:font/ttf;base64,") format("truetype");
    font-weight: normal;
    font-style: normal;
}

html,
body,
body *,
button,
input,
textarea,
select,
option,
a,
p,
span,
div,
section,
article,
header,
footer,
nav,
h1,
h2,
h3,
h4,
h5,
h6,
label,
li,
td,
th,
*::before,
*::after {
    font-family: "Irken Alphabet FIXED", sans-serif !important;
}
